items.fullText: Spain-Based Startups Advance Regional Innovation With Barcelona Supercomputing Center Part of NVIDIA Inception and the BSC AI Factory Accelerator Programme, the companies are advancing technologies for healthcare providers, utilities and more. October 19, 2026 by Tobias Halloran 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! The Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC) ’s AI Factory Accelerator Programme, now in full operation following a pilot initiative, gives startups access to sovereign compute, technical support and training to support innovation across industries. Many of these companies are also members of the NVIDIA Inception program for cutting-edge startups — and as of today, access to some of the BSC AI Factory services are available through the NVIDIA Inception portal . NVIDIA Inception complements the BSC AI Factory Accelerator Programme by providing members with training through NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute open courses, business mentoring, venture capital connections and other resources. An upcoming extension of MareNostrum 5 — BSC’s public infrastructure serving scientific and technological innovation, powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing — will deliver supercomputing access through the BSC AI Factory and other AI Factories across Europe. BSC AI Factory is among Europe’s first AI factories and the first in Spain, and has delivered more than 800 services to private and public-sector clients since its April 2025 launch. items.t: Walmart’s Flipkart is quietly building a food delivery challenger in India
items.d: Flipkart has expanded access to its food-delivery service to thousands of employees ahead of its public launch.
items.fullText: Flipkart, the Walmart-owned Indian e-commerce giant, is preparing to challenge India’s food-delivery duopoly of Zomato and Swiggy. It is entering a fiercely competitive market that has defeated even previous attempts by Amazon and Google to break in. The Bengaluru-based company is testing its food-delivery service internally and has expanded the trial from a few hundred employees to upwards of 8,000, according to two people familiar with the matter. It has also deployed a dedicated fleet of riders through its logistics arm, Ekart, separate from the riders who handle its quick-commerce deliveries, as it prepares for a public launch. The employee-only service appears as a separate tab on Flipkart’s main shopping app, alongside its Minutes quick-commerce offering and travel bookings, TechCrunch has learned. It draws on restaurants listed through ONDC, a government-backed network that connects online buyers and sellers across different platforms , as well as restaurants that Flipkart signed up directly. Riders wearing jerseys bearing the “Eat-in by Minutes” branding have also begun fulfilling orders on the streets of Bengaluru, the southern Indian city where Flipkart is headquartered. As Flipkart expands its food-delivery operations, it is entering a market that the brokerage firm Bernstein estimates is growing 18% to 20% a year. Online delivery, though, still accounts for just over 15% of India’s broader food-services industry. Zomato, owned by Eternal, and Swiggy together serve an estimated 85 million to 95 million paying customers a year, per Bernstein. That figure shows how dominant the two are, and how much room newcomers have to grow online food ordering in the world’s most populous country, which has more than a billion internet subscriptions. items.fullText: Media CNN’s Christiane Amanpour to depart network after 43 years “I’m very sorry to see her go, but I’ve come to accept that this is the right time for her, both personally and professionally,” CNN chief executive Mark Thompson said. Fabrice Coffrini / AFP via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 19, 2026, 11:25 AM EDT / Updated Oct. 19, 2026, 12:25 PM EDT By Daniel Arkin and Adam Reiss Christiane Amanpour, CNN’s chief international anchor and a fixture of the 24/7 news network for more than four decades, plans to leave the company in June. “After more than 43 years at CNN, Christiane has decided that the time is right to begin a new chapter,” Mark Thompson, CNN’s chief executive, said in a letter to newsroom employees that was obtained by NBC News. Thompson said Amanpour, 68, plans to “scale back” her eponymous CNN International show to once a week early in 2027. “The program will conclude in May,” Thompson added, “and she will leave CNN at the end of June.” “Christiane has thought carefully about this decision, and she and I have been discussing it for some months,” Thompson said. “Like so many CNNers who will hear the news today, I’m very sorry to see her go, but I’ve come to accept that this is the right time for her, both personally and professionally.” Amanpour has covered nearly every major international conflict and global crisis of the last four decades, including the fall of the Berlin Wall, the Bosnian War, the Persian Gulf War, the post-9/11 U.S. wars in Iraq and Afghanistan, the Arab Spring, Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and Israel’s war in Gaza. She has also interviewed world leaders, including former President Bill Clinton, former British Prime Minister Tony Blair, former Libyan strongman Moammar Gadhafi and various Iranian presidents, including Mahmoud Ahmadinejad and Hassan Rouhani. items.t: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
items.d: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.
items.fullText: If there’s one lesson the OpenAI-Hugging Face incident taught us, it’s that AI agents can be unpredictable. “Imagine if something like that happened in the physical world,” Howie Sun, CEO and co-founder of Laplace Intelligence , told TechCrunch. “AI agents are moving from computers into the real world, and we don’t really want physical AI to fail in the real world.” Ann Arbor-based Laplace is building automated red-teaming — essentially, stress-testing a system by deliberately trying to make it fail — for robotics and physical AI. The company is betting that the only way to make sure physical AI is safe is to have AI test it. “Our goal is to help companies discover and fix problems before deployment — and, over time, build a shared foundation of evidence that customers, insurers, and regulators can trust,” Sun said. Laplace is one of 20 startups competing in Startup Battlefield 200, the startup pitch competition taking place at TechCrunch Disrupt in San Francisco this week, October 13-15. It will present on the Disrupt Stage Tuesday afternoon , October 13. Howie Sun, CEO, Laplace Intelligence. Image Credits: Laplace Intelligence Sun, alongside his co-founder and chief scientist Henry Liu, founded Laplace a year ago out of the University of Michigan. Sun has spent the last eight years in academia researching how to challenge autonomous driving AI in simulation. In 2023, he and Liu — his then-PhD adviser — published a paper on the subject that made it onto the cover of the top scientific journal Nature. That’s when the calls started coming in from autonomous vehicle companies interested in implementing their ideas. “I realized that I wanted to build this and take it from purely academic research into a product that’s useful in the real world,” Sun said. items.t: Cracks are beginning to show in the stock market as doubts about AI investments grow
items.d: Consumers already face a host of stressors. If AI spending and tech stocks show signs of sustained decline, U.S. economic growth could be at risk.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Cracks are beginning to show in the stock market as doubts about AI investments grow Consumers already face a host of stressors. If AI spending and tech stocks show signs of sustained decline, U.S. economic growth could be at risk. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nearly half of all U.S. economy growth this year is attributable to tech-related spending, which has lifted the stock market to record highs. Michael M. Santiago / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 15, 2026, 11:38 AM EDT / Updated Oct. 15, 2026, 5:33 PM EDT By Rob Wile Just one week after hitting fresh all-time highs, U.S. stocks are showing signs of strain as investors begin to fret about returns on the trillions of dollars that have been put into AI. For U.S. consumers, it could mean a shakier economy moving forward. After trading closed Thursday, the S&P 500 was off 1% from its week-ago record, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq had fallen more than 3% below its peak last week. Driving the declines: Quarterly revenue growth at Anthropic has slowed, the Financial Times reported Wednesday. The AI giant is expected to be worth more than $1 trillion when it goes public, and at nearly $17 billion, its revenue is still massive and the company said it is profitable. There are also rising concerns about whether China-based memory technology companies could undermine, or even overtake, their Western rivals. And even though the AI data center buildout has created a global shortage of processing chips, there are fears that Chinese mass production of memory chips could flood the market with an oversupply. Meanwhile, investors have begun selling off the bonds backing some data centers , primarily over fears that AI revenues won’t be sufficient to cover the massive sums that have been borrowed to finance the building of the centers. items.fullText: Dial Up the Cloud: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Controls Arrive on GeForce NOW Plus, stream ‘Enshrouded’ 1.0 and ‘Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2’ alongside 10 new games this week. October 15, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Dial in the next gaming session this GFN Thursday. New NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 controls give GeForce NOW members more choice over how supported games look and perform in the cloud, even without the latest hardware. Then, step into the Shroud as Keen Games’ Enshrouded leaves early access with its 1.0 release, or let the bolts fly in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 . Both are streaming on GeForce NOW at launch. With 10 new games joining the cloud this week, members can put the new controls to work in supported titles and keep playing across supported devices without downloads, installs or expensive hardware upgrades. Fine-Tune the Cloud With DLSS 4.5 Controls More control, more cloud power. NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 controls are now available on GeForce NOW, giving members more choice over how supported games look and perform in the cloud, even without the latest hardware. DLSS Super Resolution sharpens image quality, while Dynamic Multi Frame Generation delivers lower latency and reduces stutter for smoother streaming, and Ray Reconstruction enhances ray-traced visuals. In addition, Ultimate members streaming on GeForce RTX 5080-powered cloud rigs benefit from the maximum available options, including Dynamic Multi Frame Generation up to 4X. From James Bond’s globe-trotting missions in 007 First Light — now with path tracing support — to CONTROL Resonant ’s reality-bending Manhattan and the shadowy scares of Resident Evil Requiem , the controls help fine-tune supported games for image quality, responsiveness or a preferred balance between the two. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Advanced Technology Access for Europe’s Scientific Community Through Open Learning Resources, Collaborations and Compute NVIDIA’s participation in the European Commission’s AI in Science Enablers Initiative deepens its commitment to supporting the pursuit of scientific progress across the region. October 15, 2026 by Rod Evans 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Much of today’s scientific progress begins with computation. But turning accelerated computing’s potential into scientific progress — modeling climate systems, designing molecules, simulating materials and more — depends on more than breakthrough technology. Especially for smaller labs, early-career scientists or science-based startups, the hardest part of research can be everything that comes before the science: assembling tools, finding compute and building the expertise to use both. At the AI in Science Summit in Dublin today, the European Commission launched the AI in Science Enablers Initiative, a shared framework connected to RAISE — the Resource for AI Science in Europe — that brings private-sector support closer to Europe’s research community. items.fullText: 삼성전자, 동남아 가전 테크세미나 개최… 맞춤형 AI 가전·통합 공조 솔루션 선보여 2026/10/15 AI 요약 새로운 뉴스룸 AI 기능을 살펴보세요! 닫기 --> AUDIO Play Download 공유 레이어 열기 인쇄하기 삼성전자가 14일 베트남 하노이에서 동남아 가전 테크세미나 ‘더 브리프(The Brief)’를 열고, 현지 사용자의 라이프스타일에 최적화된 AI 가전과 B2B 솔루션을 선보였다. 이번 행사는 지난 8월 개관한 삼성 ‘비즈니스 익스피리언스 스튜디오 (Business Experience Studio, 이하 BES)’에서 진행됐다. 하노이 PVI 타워에 위치한 베트남 BES는 삼성전자의 다양한 제품과 솔루션을 상업시설 콘셉트로 구현한 전시공간이다. 행사에는 태국, 베트남, 싱가포르 등 동남아 국가의 주요 미디어와 인플루언서들이 참석했다. AI 기반 푸드 경험부터 원격 케어까지…차별화된 AI 홈 경험 제공 삼성전자는 가전이 사용자의 라이프스타일과 상황을 이해하고 이에 맞춰 기기를 제어하거나 솔루션을 제안하는 다양한 AI 홈 경험을 소개했다. 특히 냉장고에 탑재된 카메라 기반으로 식재료를 효율적으로 보관·관리할 수 있도록 돕는 ‘AI 비전’ 기능을 시연했다. 사용자는 ‘AI 비전’을 통해 식재료의 입출고 현황을 실시간으로 확인할 수 있다. 자주 사용하는 식재료는 자동으로 데이터베이스에 저장되고 냉장고는 이 정보를 토대로 구매가 필요한 식재료를 알려준다. 이외에도 ▲한 주간의 식재료 사용을 분석해서 리포트 형태로 제공하는 ‘푸드노트(Food Note)’ ▲냉장고 속 식재료를 기반으로 맞춤 레시피를 추천하는 ‘오늘 뭐 먹지?(What’s for Today?)’ 등 다양한 기능을 제공한다. 삼성전자는 ▲전문 상담사가 원격으로 기기의 상태를 정밀하게 분석하고 적절한 조치 방법을 안내해 주는 ‘가전제품 원격지원(HRM)’ ▲와이파이 탑재 제품 대상으로 지원하는 최대 7년간 무상 소프트웨어 업그레이드 등 차별화된 제품 케어 서비스도 소개했다. 주거공간부터 상업시설까지 아우르는 통합 공조 솔루션 선보여 삼성전자는 고온 다습한 동남아 기후와 현지 사용 환경을 반영해 주거공간과 상업시설까지 다양한 공간에 최적화된 냉방 경험을 제공하는 공조 솔루션도 선보였다. 주거용 제품으로는 사용자의 생활 패턴과 공간 환경에 맞춰 냉기 흐름을 제어하는 ‘비스포크 AI 무풍콤보 프로 벽걸이’ 에어컨을 소개했다. 이 제품은 공간을 구분해 냉기 방향을 섬세하게 제어하는 ‘모션 블레이드’와 사용자의 위치·활동량·부재 등을 감지하는 ‘모션 레이더 센서’를 갖춰 사용자의 취향과 환경에 최적화된 냉방을 제공한다. B2B 전용 제품으로는 호텔, 사무실 등 대형 건물에 적용할 수 있는 시스템에어컨 실외기 ‘DVM S2’와 실내기 ‘무풍 1WAY·4WAY 천장형 카세트’를 전시했다. 또 에어컨과 다양한 IoT 기기들을 하나의 플랫폼에 연결하고 다수의 사업장의 기기 상태와 에너지 사용량 등을 한 눈에 관리할 수 있는 B2B 연결·통합 제어 플랫폼 ‘스마트싱스 프로’를 시연했다. 삼성전자 DA사업부 이상직 부사장은 “삼성전자의 차별화된 AI 기술과 연결성을 기반으로 동남아 고객과 B2B 파트너 모두에게 실질적인 가치와 편의를 제공할 것 “이라고 말했다. ▲ 삼성전자가 14일 베트남 하노이에서 열린 삼성 동남아 가전 테크세미나 ‘더 브리프’에서 냉장고에 탑재된 카메라 기반으로 식재료를 효율적으로 보관·관리할 수 있도록 돕는 ‘AI 비전’ 기능을 시연했다. ▲ 삼성전자가 14일 베트남 하노이에서 열린 삼성 동남아 가전 테크세미나 ‘더 브리프’에서 사용자의 생활 패턴과 공간 환경에 맞춰

items.fullText: 삼성전자, ‘실리콘밸리 미래 통신 서밋 2026’ 개최 2026/10/15 AI 요약 새로운 뉴스룸 AI 기능을 살펴보세요! 닫기 --> AUDIO Play Download 공유 레이어 열기 인쇄하기 삼성전자가 현지시간 14일부터 15일까지 미국 실리콘밸리 마운틴뷰에서 글로벌 통신 업계 파트너들과 차세대 네트워크의 미래를 논의하는 자리를 마련한다. 삼성전자는 14일에 ‘파트너 데이(Partner Day)’를 진행했고, 15일에는 ‘실리콘밸리 미래 통신 서밋 2026(Silicon Valley Future Wireless Summit 2026)’을 개최한다. ▲ 14일(현지시간) 미국 실리콘밸리 마운틴뷰에서 진행된 ‘파트너 데이’ 행사 전경. 이번 행사에는 주요 이동통신사∙제조사∙정부 기관∙학계 리더 등 100여 명의 통신 전문가들이 참석해 AI와 다가올 6G 시대 소프트웨어 기반의 네트워크 진화 방향과 통신 산업의 가치 창출을 위한 생태계 협력 방안을 논의한다. 또한, 삼성전자는 ‘AI 내재형 6G 네트워크’ 기술 개발 성과 등을 선보인다. AI 시대의 네트워크 가치 창출을 위한 글로벌 협력 14일 파트너 데이 참석자들은 AI기반 통신산업의 변화에 대응하기 위한 소프트웨어 기반 네트워크 전략과 생태계 차원의 협력 방안을 논의했다. 삼성전자는 기조연설을 통해 AI가 애플리케이션과 서비스를 넘어 인프라 전반을 변화시키면서, 100여 년간 이어진 통신 네트워크도 구조적으로 재편되고 있다고 설명했다. 특히, AI와 가상화를 융합한 차세대 네트워크는 기존의 한계를 넘어 인류가 상상해 온 새로운 방식의 커뮤니케이션을 실현하는 핵심 동력이 될 것이라고 강조했다. ▲ 14일(현지시간) 미국 실리콘밸리 마운틴뷰에서 진행된 ‘파트너 데이’에서 삼성전자 네트워크사업부장 김우준 사장이 기조연설을 하고 있다. 이후, 통신 업계의 집단지성을 모아 AI 시대 네트워크 진화 전략과 방향을 본격적으로 논의하는 시간을 가졌다. 패널 세션에서는 통신 사업자들이 AI 기반 미래 네트워크의 요구사항과 청사진을 공유하고, 제조사들은 AI와 가상화 네트워크 상용화 과정에서 축적한 경험을 나누며 통신 생태계의 지속적인 발전 방향을 논의했다. 또, 단순한 연결 서비스를 넘어 새로운 네트워크 기반 신규 서비스를 발굴해 새로운 사업 기회로 연결하기 위한 방안을 다각도로 모색했다. 삼성전자 네트워크사업부 전략마케팅팀장 박정호 부사장은 “AI 시대의 네트워크는 쏟아지는 신규 서비스의 다양한 요구를 읽고, 가상화를 기반으로 유연하게 변화하며 최적의 답을 제시하는 지능형 인프라로 진화하고 있다”며, “삼성전자는 글로벌 파트너들과 함께 가상화 네트워크의 대규모 상용화를 성공적으로 이뤄왔다. 여기에 앞선 AI 기술을 더해 통신 인프라를 새로운 성장 엔진으로 발전시키고, 업계가 함께 도약하는 길을 앞장서 열어 나가겠다”고 말했다. AI가 불러올 무선 통신의 혁신… 네트워크의 혁신과 확장 15일 개최되는 ‘실리콘밸리 미래 통신 서밋 2026’은 ▲AI 내재형 6G 네트워크(AI-Native 6G Networks) ▲위성통신 기반 6G 커버리지 확장(Taking 6G to Space With NTN) ▲현실과 가상 세계를 잇는 초연결(Connecting the Physical and Digital Worlds) 등 총 3개 세션으로 운영되며, 참가자들은 패널 토의를 통해 자유롭게 질의하고 토론하는 시간을 가진다. ‘AI 내재형 6G 네트워크’ 세션에서는 AI를 통신망 성능과 운영효율 혁신의 핵심 기술로 삼아, 6G 네트워크의 지능형 인프라 진화를 위한 기술적 과제와 협력 방안이 논의된다. ‘위성통신 기반 6G 커버리지 확장’ 세션에서는 저궤도 위성군집의 현황과 미래 전망을 살펴보고 우주 통신의 기술적 장벽과 그 해법으로서의 위성 통신에 대해 토론

items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces New Investments in the UK Startup Ecosystem UK organizations across healthcare, finance, local government and climate science are putting NVIDIA AI to work. October 13, 2026 by Anthony Hills 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Across industries, the U.K. is putting the full stack to work. T he scale of deployment is growing fast, from enterprises transforming their businesses to startups solving some of the planet’s hardest problems. NVIDIA is putting that principle into practice, including through a five-year, $250 million compute commitment to strengthen the U.K.’s agentic safety and security research. NVIDIA’s Investments in the UK NVIDIA has been investing in the U.K. startup ecosystem, supporting companies including Basecamp Research , Ineffable Intelligence , Synthesia , Wayve and many more. Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Boltz , Foresight , Hiverge, Prima Mente and Riverlane . Boltz , a London-based AI startup founded by MIT researchers, builds biomolecular models and AI agents that help scientists predict molecular structures and interactions, and design potential new medicines. Foresight, a London-based startup, helps owners of major infrastructure projects, including hyperscale data centers, predict completion dates, mitigate risks and accelerate time to revenue. Hiverge , a Cambridge-based AI startup founded by researchers from Google DeepMind and the University of Cambridge, builds an AI discovery engine that automatically writes and optimizes algorithms for tasks such as faster AI training and complex logistics planning. Prima Mente , a London-based AI biology startup, focuses on building biological foundation models to decode complex diseases and identify novel therapeutic targets, starting with Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s and ALS. items.d: The NASA and SpaceX Crew-13 mission launched successfully from Cape Canaveral, Florida, toward the International Space Station. NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney are joined by Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov and CSA astronaut Joshua Kutryk.
